name: Shiina Mafuyu
source:
A freshman who is the student council treasurer and also [url=/c67837]Minatsu's[/url] younger who has a deep interest in BL and video games. Mafuyu extremely passive and keeps a lot to herself, having a weak, kind and shy appearance, but she will show her real self and her real feelings if she feels comfortable. She also runs a popular website called 'Internal Organs Explode' where she sells BL.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Student_Council%27s_Discretion]Wikipedia[/url]]
